tickets.subject: Comprehensive feedback after 6 months of usage
tickets.message:
Dear TechCorp Product Team,

I've been using TechCorp extensively for the past 6 months across multiple teams in our organization. Here's my detailed feedback:

WHAT WE LOVE:
- Intuitive interface, minimal training required
- Excellent mobile apps
- Reliable performance (99% uptime in our experience)
- Great customer support response times
- The recent dashboard redesign is fantastic

AREAS FOR IMPROVEMENT:
- Need better Gantt chart functionality
- Custom reporting could be more flexible
- Would like to see time tracking built-in
- Bulk editing capabilities are limited
- Integration with Jira could be deeper

OVERALL: 8/10 - We're happy with the platform and have recommended it to partner companies. With the improvements above, it would be a 10/10.

Happy to hop on a call to discuss further if helpful.

Best regards,
Amanda Foster
Director of Operations, ScaleUp Technologies
Growth Plan Customer since July 2024
